A Surprise Expansion of the Derry Mythos

In a move intended to mark the Halloween holiday, HBO Max has launched a surprise, standalone episode of its prequel series, *It: Welcome to Derry*. The special, titled "A Story of Derry," is now available for subscribers to stream.

Episode Details

  • Run Time: The special episode has a runtime of approximately 30 minutes.
  • Logline: The narrative focuses on three young individuals entering the Western Wood centuries before the reign of Pennywise, where they encounter an ancient, terrifying entity.
  • Promotional Material: HBO Max shared a brief clip via Instagram showing a Native American character navigating the woods with a bow and arrow, signaling a historical setting for this installment.

Context and Future Developments

*It: Welcome to Derry* originally premiered on the platform on October 26, 2025. Serving as a prequel to the popular 2017 and 2019 film adaptations, the series explores the sinister history of the fictional Maine town.

Looking toward the future of the franchise, showrunner Brad Caleb Kane has shared updates regarding the second season:

  • Setting: Season 2 is expected to take place in 1935, during the Great Depression.
  • Plot Focus: The upcoming season is reported to center on the massacre of the Bradley Gang, a group of bank robbers whose history in Derry is featured in Stephen King’s 1986 source novel.
  • Production Status: Scripts are currently being written, with the production team moving forward on casting and planning for a release window estimated for late 2027 or 2028.
  • Character Evolution: Kane has indicated that Bill Skarsgård will return as Pennywise, though the character will be portrayed in a manner distinct from previous iterations.

How to Verify

Viewers can confirm the availability of the new content by accessing their HBO Max dashboard or the official show page on the streaming platform. Official updates regarding production schedules and series renewals are typically disseminated through HBO's verified press channels and the show's official social media profiles.
